summary: The running game's XF bridge: whether a session file names a live game, its replies to commands, and capture files.
rate: Up to 18 requests a second in bursts of 36.

x-friction.gap: The game plugin refuses more than 20 requests a second; the client paces, bursts and retries after refusal, and game facts are only as fresh as the last reply.
x-friction.closes: Paced request sources with retries and reconnection, and an age on each observation.
